pain_points.text: Customers fear delicate sarees coming back with colour bleed or lost zari; it is the most repeated complaint about local dry cleaners.
pain_points.source: Google reviews of 3 Vijay Nagar dry cleaners, 30 read, weighted to 2-3 stars (2026-11-20)

pain_points.text: Pickup slots that are missed without a call are the second most common complaint.
pain_points.source: Google reviews of 3 Vijay Nagar dry cleaners, 30 read (2026-11-20)

working_angles.text: Show the saree-care process step by step (stain test, hand finish, tissue fold); no local competitor shows process, all show prices.
working_angles.source: Outlier read of 4 accounts, 48 reels; process reels were the top 2 multiples (2026-11-21)

outlier_hooks.text: Opens on a ruined silk dupatta held to camera with 'Ye galti mat karna' on screen; reveals the fix in 3 steps.

details.hook_spoken: Shaadi se pehle ye galti mat karna

competitors_overdo.text: Price-list carousels (per-piece rates on a coloured background): all four direct competitors post them weekly and their multiples stay under 1x.

timely_hooks.text: Wedding season (Nov-Feb): pre-wedding outfit care and 'lehenga after the wedding' storage are searched and discussed now.
timely_hooks.source: Web search: Indore wedding season articles and local event listings, 5 searches (2026-11-20)

customer_phrases.source: Comments on the top 5 outlier reels, 120 read (2026-11-21)

customer_phrases.text: pickup time pe aate hi nahi
customer_phrases.source: Google reviews of 3 Vijay Nagar dry cleaners, 30 read (2026-11-20)

proof_points.text: Customers trust a named person who handles silk ('bhaiya ne khud dekha'); reviews that mention a person score higher.
proof_points.source: Google reviews of 3 Vijay Nagar dry cleaners, 30 read (2026-11-20)

visual_cliches.text: Stock photos of white shirts on hangers and washing-machine clip art; every direct competitor uses them.

competitor_ads.text: A flat 20% off on first order, running 41 days in 3 versions: survived, probably a standing offer.

not_read: Instagram hashtag #indorelaundry: thin (11 reels); used the city-level home-services tag instead
summary: First research for Shubh Laundry: saree-care fear is the top pain point; process reels beat price lists; wedding season is the timely hook.
